tools.name: search_checks
tools.description: Find Trakis checks by a word or a problem, when you do not know the check's code. Searches titles, what each check looks at, why it matters and where the problem usually comes from. Returns up to 10 checks, best matches first.

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: The full explanation of one Trakis check: what it looks at, why it matters, where the problem usually comes from, how to fix it (with a worked example when there is one), how to verify it without Trakis, and how an audit counts it.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Every check a Trakis audit runs, optionally only one category or one severity, with its code, title and a link to its explanation.
